campaign.name: Build What's Next
campaign.objective: Generate qualified discovery calls from business leaders who need software development capability without building a large permanent engineering team.
campaign.business_goal: 30 qualified discovery calls within the first 90 days (supplied campaign target; not a performance claim).

primary.description: Ireland and UK organisations with 50–1,000 employees, a meaningful software or digital initiative, and insufficient internal engineering capacity.
firmographics: existing digital product or significant software requirement
buying_triggers: Active software, product, AI, modernisation, or digital-transformation initiative paired with insufficient internal capacity

secondary: Product and engineering leadership as influencers

strategy.problem: Important delivery work is constrained by capacity, hiring pressure, or the burden of assembling multiple providers.
strategy.desired_outcome: A credible senior team able to support a product initiative from discovery to production without permanent-team overhead.
strategy.positioning: AI-native software development agency combining senior software engineering expertise with AI-assisted development.
strategy.offer: A discovery call or conversation with an engineer about the initiative.

message_hierarchy.master_message: Your next software team doesn't have to be on your payroll.
message_hierarchy.primary_message: Forge Labs combines senior software expertise with AI-powered development to take products from idea to production.

claims.claim: Forge Labs is an AI-native software development agency.
Forge Labs supports clients from product discovery through production.
AI tools and agents are used throughout delivery to accelerate delivery.
Forge Labs is 10x faster, 50% cheaper, Ireland's #1, or trusted by Fortune 500 companies.
Any unprovided customer proof, metric, ranking, guarantee, comparison, award, testimonial, partnership, or certification.

creative_territories.name: Your next software team
creative_territories.insight: Leaders with an important software initiative need capability, not necessarily permanent headcount.
creative_territories.core_message: Your next software team doesn't have to be on your payroll.
creative_territories.emotional_angle: Relief and momentum without a false promise of effortless delivery.
creative_territories.headline_direction: YOUR NEXT SOFTWARE TEAM DOESN'T HAVE TO BE ON YOUR PAYROLL.
risks: Do not imply that outsourcing is automatically cheaper or faster.

creative_territories.name: From idea to production
creative_territories.insight: Fragmented discovery, design, engineering, and launch work can slow a serious initiative.
creative_territories.core_message: From product idea to production, with one senior team.
creative_territories.emotional_angle: Confidence in a coherent delivery path.
risks: Do not claim a guaranteed launch date or outcome.

creative_territories.name: Senior thinking, AI-powered delivery
creative_territories.insight: Buyers want modern AI-assisted delivery without giving up experienced engineering judgment.
risks: Avoid AI hype, automation guarantees, and unapproved speed claims.

campaign_platform.big_idea: Draft for T1 only: Build the capability your next initiative needs, without building the permanent department it does not.
campaign_platform.master_message: Your next software team doesn't have to be on your payroll.
campaign_platform.creative_direction: Dark, premium, structured modular components resolving into a clear product/system shape, with a selective Forge Orange connection point.
campaign_platform.visual_or_experiential_anchor: Interlocking modular blocks represent a team assembled for the work; they must not imply a customer system or outcome.
cross_channel_coherence_rules: Lead awareness with the payroll/headcount tension and consideration with proof.
Use approved wording or a channel-native expression; do not introduce a competing campaign line.
Use only the approved Forge Labs palette and typography.
Use modular, connected, credible team/product visuals; avoid generic AI/cyber imagery and unapproved logos.
Use Book a discovery call as conversion CTA; QR/URL requires approval.
